title: OverflowMenu configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.OverflowMenuAPI.Create, parsed. Invalid values fall back to the defaults at runtime; unknown properties are ignored. Generated by scripts/ai-docs/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

Position.description: Preferred placement of the menu relative to its trigger (GlobalEnum.FloatingPosition); auto picks the best fit.

Shape.description: Corner shape of the menu: SoftRounded (default), Rounded or Sharp.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
